title: Stronger states, 1900-1930
goal: Say what the new states created, with the passive with *se*.

items: I can say what was created or introduced, with *se* + a verb.
I can say what governments lived on around 1900 and what changed by 1930.
I can say what the new ministries, central banks and taxes were for.
I can use the words *el ministerio*, *el impuesto*, *el funcionario* and *la aduana*.
